The staff is incredibly helpful and understanding, attentive to the needs of every dog ​​and their owners! Their love for our four-legged friends shines through in every gesture.

Professionalism, kindness, and above all, a great love for animals.
I have a small dog (5 kg), and I've noticed great care taken to place him in a group that protects him from the potential aggressiveness of much larger dogs. The result is that the little guy can't wait to go play with his furry friends of all sizes—never a problem. He comes home tired and happy, and I smile when I look at photos and videos of him enjoying this space of freedom and safe socialization.
Very competent and professional, our dogs are truly in the hands of art with them.

Great professionalism, kindness, and helpfulness, all topped off with a friendly, lighthearted, and fun atmosphere. My little devil really enjoys working with them; when he sees the van, he goes crazy with joy, and that makes me feel truly at ease. Highly recommended.
Affectionate and always available for any emergency!

Great professionalism, availability, and infinite love for our four-legged friends. Personally, my puppy doesn't feel separated from us, neither at the boarding kennel nor at the daycare. When they come to pick him up, he jumps straight into the van, and this makes you understand that he gets along great with them.
Their love for dogs is paramount, and their professionalism, kindness, and helpfulness are what set them apart. We couldn't live without Candemonio.

Indiana wasn't even a year old when she went to Candemonium, and since then she's always been happy to go. Even now, at 3, she's so happy when she sees some of her old teachers.
This can only mean one thing: she's happy and happy, and frankly, so am I.
Thank you guys. Kisses from me and Indiana.
Excellent center! The instructors are excellent and very affectionate, and my dog ​​is always excited to go there. He has a blast every time—highly recommended.

Professionalism, but above all, passion and love for our furry friends, who are cared for, monitored, and pampered by the entire staff.
Maximum availability and
an efficient taxi service.
Not least, the ability to leave my Manu even on rainy days because they have covered spaces... it's a lifesaver.
My dachshund has been going to Candemonio for over two years...
we're super satisfied...try it and believe it!
Best place to leave furry kids, my Queen would never want to go home❤️
When Dexter arrived at Candemonio he was only 8 months old... now he's 5 years old... That says it all. What can I say? I don't recommend it... I HIGHLY RECOMMEND it! 🥰🥰🥰 …

Great professionalism and so much affection! Darma and I get along great.
Even the pension has proven to be a guarantee.
This is enough: Cory, my dog, knows that when my cell rings around 8:30 or 9:00, they're coming to pick her up to go to Candemonio. And the leaps of joy are uncontrollable...
This is Achilles' smile when he goes to kindergarten! You're the best!
People who clearly love our four-legged friends, qualified and available in everything to make us and our furry friends happy 🥰🥰🥰 …
Kind, empathetic, and patient, my dog ​​has been with Candemonio for almost three years and has improved dramatically, becoming more docile and easier to handle. Practically her second family.
My dogs always come home happy and tired after a morning at daycare, they are looked after well and professionally.
